title: MIDDAY PRAYER
PSALM THIRTY FOUR
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through a quiet empty window
peaceful sunny room with a wooden table and soft light
golden noon light casting long gentle shadows across an empty desk
clear blue noon sky over a quiet open landscape
gentle sunbeams falling on a calm wooden surface at noon
serene bright morning light glowing softly through tall glass windows

scenes.a: That sudden knot in your stomach about what happens next is what brought you here.
Father, right now in the middle of this busy day, we bring every hidden fear directly to Your presence.
As it is written, I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
Lord, let Your comforting grace quiet our racing thoughts and steady our trembling hands this very hour.
O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
